Results.ReviewText:
Traeger listened, learned, and delivered improvements.  On older models, there was too much of a gap between the drip tray and the sides of the grill. That made it easy for grease to miss the drip tray and run down the grill towards the fire pot. The new design drastically reduces that gap.
The auger/fan assembly was moved to underneath the main body, held on by 4 bolts. This is a much improved design if you need to access those parts for repair. The grease trap being moved to underneath now keeps me from knock8ng the fan off every time I take the cover off. The features added on the controller are very nice for the price point. This is a lot of grill for $1,000 and improved in most areas over the older pro and ironwood models I've previously owned.
Results.Title: Great value for the money!
